metadata.description: Open strategy frameworks for AI agents — 11 skills that turn any LLM into a strategy thinking partner. Built on 20 years of consulting practice.

plugins.name: eterdis-strategy-diagnostic
plugins.description: Entry point — AI-guided strategic assessment that detects which frameworks are most relevant and produces a strategy-ready brief.

plugins.name: eterdis-strategy-map
plugins.description: Two-directional causal chain analysis. Bottom-up from resources to results, top-down from expectations to requirements.

plugins.name: eterdis-vrio
plugins.description: VRIO resource analysis combined with Dynamic Capabilities assessment — test whether your advantages are real and durable.

plugins.name: eterdis-environmental-radar
plugins.description: Continuous PESTEL environmental scanning across six categories. Three modes: full scan, monthly review, alert triggers.

plugins.name: eterdis-market-position
plugins.description: Competitive positioning diagnostic — figure out where you actually stand and whether that position is defensible.

plugins.name: eterdis-wardley-map
plugins.description: Wardley Mapping — map your value chain, plot component evolution, and spot strategic plays that movement creates.

plugins.name: eterdis-culture
plugins.description: Culture assessment — surface the gap between declared culture and actual culture. Three modes: Diagnostic, Review, Alert Triggers.

plugins.name: eterdis-first-principles
plugins.description: First-principles strategy — find the theoretical maximum for your business and work backwards to your first move.

plugins.name: eterdis-playing-to-win
plugins.description: Lafley/Martin Playing to Win strategy cascade — five interconnected choices that define a real strategy.

plugins.name: eterdis-pre-mortem
plugins.description: Stress-test plans by imagining they've already failed. Six failure categories, the monkey test, and concrete adjustments.

plugins.name: eterdis-protoloop
plugins.description: Track Two innovation system for running small, fast experiments outside the core business.
